item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Sharif built a narrowly lawful system for emergency powers, surveillance, or anti-terror administration with credible judicial or civilian checks. The available record is instead dominated by coercive shutdowns, political policing, and weakened judicial independence.","evidence":[{"title":"PM for collective efforts to eliminate menace of terrorism","publisher":"Radio Pakistan","date":"2024-06-22","url":"https://www.radio.gov.pk/22-06-2024/pm-for-collective-efforts-to-eliminate-menace-of-terrorism","summary":"Sharif launched a national counterterrorism campaign with provincial consensus and said the armed forces would be supported with necessary resources. This supports a narrow-security rationale, though it does not itself show safeguards against abuse.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.2"]},{"title":"Election-day internet shutdown is a reckless attack on peoples' rights","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-02-08","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/02/pakistan-election-day-internet-shutdown-is-a-reckless-attack-on-peoples-rights/","summary":"Amnesty condemned the telecom and mobile internet shutdown as a rights violation during the election period. This is direct evidence of coercive administrative control used against a politically charged public.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Pakistan government intensifies crackdown on political dissent","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-10-09","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/10/09/pakistan-government-intensifies-crackdown-political-dissent","summary":"HRW reported over 500 arrests, tear gas, roadblocks, mobile internet cuts, and arrests for peaceful protest. That is strong evidence that security tools were used for intimidation and collective repression, not narrowly targeted law enforcement.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Pakistani police detain two parliamentarians in swoop on ex-PM Khan's party","publisher":"Reuters / ThePrint","date":"2024-09-10","url":"https://theprint.in/world/pakistani-police-detain-two-parliamentarians-in-swoop-on-ex-pm-khans-party/2260202/","summary":"Police detained PTI parliamentarians after a rally demanding Khan’s release. This is evidence of administrative and policing powers being used against opponents, with no clear contemporaneous signal of restraint or independent review.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.2"]},{"title":"Pakistan authorities must end escalating attacks on minority Ahmadiyya community","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-06-21","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/end-escalating-attacks-on-minority-ahmadiyya-community/","summary":"Amnesty documented arbitrary arrests, police harassment, and orders blocking Ahmadi rites. This is the clearest evidence that local administrative power and policing were being used to control and punish a minority community.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.1","3B.2"]},{"title":"Pakistan's government curbs judiciary's power after alleged harassment of MPs","publisher":"The Guardian","date":"2024-10-21","url":"https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/oct/21/pakistans-government-curbs-judiciarys-power-after-alleged-harassment-of-mps","summary":"The 26th amendment was passed amid allegations of intimidation and abductions of MPs, and critics said it reduced judicial independence. That cuts against narrow, lawful use of emergency or security powers because it weakens oversight of abuse by politically protected actors.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.4","3B.2"]},{"title":"2024 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices: Pakistan","publisher":"U.S. Department of State","date":"2024","url":"https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128431.html","summary":"The report says the government rarely took credible steps to identify and punish officials who committed abuses. This is the main positive counterpoint, but it looks reactive and limited rather than like a built, lawful control framework.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.4"]}]}
